reviews.title: Decepcionante retorno a Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
La ubicación / La experiencia gastronómica deja bastante que desear, sobre todo en el restaurante mexicano (las tortillas frías con champiñones enlatados eran realmente penosos). Pero lo peor no fue eso; nos alojamos en el sector "exclusivo" de The reserve, una habitación swim up con acceso directo a la piscina. En reiteradas ocasiones grupos de huéspedes utilizaron parlantes personales a alto volumen, alterando completamente el ambiente de descanso y exclusividad que precisamente uno espera al elegir esta categoría. Según los propios lineamentos del hotel, esto está prohibido, sin embargo, el personal del hotel no intervino ni tomó las medidas efectivas para resguardar la experiencia de los demás huéspedes, convirtiendo una piscina "exclusiva" en una playa pública parlante.
La verdad es que podría seguir, porque hubieron varias otras situaciones que hicieron que la estadía en este resort fuera mas bien modesta. Elegí pasar mi cumpleaños acá y no fue una buena decisión. Lo lamento mucho, porque ya antes me había alojado en Paradisus Playa del Carmen (Royal Service) y en este mismo Resort Paradisus Punta Cana hace unos dos años, pero el deterioro generalizado es evidente. En resumen, no vale lo que cobran y lo peor de todo es que lo que se ofrece no es tal; no hay exclusividad, no hay respeto y el descanso pasa a ser incomodidad. No vuelvo.

reviews.title: Estadia agradável e completa
reviews.text:
Foi a minha primeira vez em um resort all inclusive, e a experiência superou todas as expectativas. Logo pela manhã, o café da manhã impressionava pela variedade e organização, com frutas frescas, pães e opções quentes bem dispostas e sempre renovadas. No almoço e no jantar, a diversidade continuava, com pratos para todos os gostos, desde culinária local até internacional, tudo muito bem apresentado.

Os restaurantes que exigem reservas, gostamos bastante da experiência, dando destaque ao Ao Asiático e ao Italiano.

A área de piscinas era ampla e convidativa, com espaços para relaxar e também para se divertir, sempre limpa e bem cuidada. Já a praia, com sua beleza natural, completava o cenário perfeito, oferecendo um ambiente tranquilo para descansar e aproveitar o dia. Foi uma experiência única, confortável e cheia de momentos agradáveis. / Apesar de a experiência no resort ter sido, no geral, muito positiva, o jantar no restaurante Mina deixou a desejar. A carne servida não estava no ponto esperado, e a apresentação do prato também não foi agradável. 

Além disso, alguns funcionários do resort não foram tão receptivos quanto o restante da equipe — embora seja justo destacar que outros atenderam muito bem. Esse contraste acabou impactando a experiência nesse momento específico.

Las facilidades del hotel están bien. A la habitación, 2210, le falta privacidad en el área del baño: las cortinas, no es suficiente. 

Necesitan leer los mensajes que uno le hace llegar a través de Booking. Chary, en recepción, alega que no le llegan los mensajes de pedido que se hacen a través de Booking, lo que dificultó el registro temprano para al menos una de las habitaciones (persona con pobre movilidad). Check-in & Zimmer-Chaos
Bei der Ankunft wurde mir mitgeteilt, dass mein gebuchtes Zimmer besetzt sei. Man gab mir eine Alternative, die jedoch ca. 500 CHF günstiger war als meine Buchung – zudem ohne die gebuchten „The Reserve“-Zusatzleistungen. Erst nach langem Hin und Her am nächsten Tag erhielt ich ein besseres Zimmer, das jedoch immer noch nicht der ursprünglichen Buchung entsprach.
Technische Mängel
Im neuen Zimmer war die Terrassentür defekt. Zudem schaltete sich der Whirlpool nachts von alleine ein und ließ sich nicht ausschalten. Es dauerte sehr lange, bis jemand kam, um das Gerät vom Strom zu trennen.
Massive Hygienemängel (Video vorhanden)
Das ist der kritischste Punkt: Das Personal im Restaurant nutzte das Eiswasser, das zum Kühlen von Wein gedacht war, um benutzte Löffel und sogar die eigenen Hände zu „reinigen“. Dasselbe Eis wurde danach an Gäste serviert! Ich habe diese unhaltbaren Zustände auf Video festgehalten.
Gesundheitliche Folgen & Kulinarik
Obwohl das Essen geschmacklich gut war, litten viele Gäste (mich eingeschlossen) unter massiven Magen-Darm-Problemen. Im Austausch mit anderen Gästen stellte sich heraus, dass mindestens drei Personen sogar mit Fieber tagelang das Bett hüten mussten.
Service
Das Personal war nur dann freundlich, wenn man Trinkgeld gab – ansonsten war der Umgangston sehr frech. Beim Frühstück gab es zudem extrem lange Wartezeiten auf Getränke.
Fazit: Ein Hotel dieser Preisklasse darf sich solche Fehler – besonders im Bereich Hygiene und bei der Einhaltung von Buchungen – nicht erlauben. Ich kann dieses Haus absolut nicht weiterempfehlen.

Then started the real problem after around one hour standing in the front desk. That there is no King size bed available and that the hotel offers the king size bed depend on the availability while in my reservation in booking it was clear that the room is King size bed. I was so mad but i didn't have another choice than accept the situation and sadly stayed in a doble bed with my wife after they promise to change our room on Monday. We had to give up 2 nights from our 6 nights.
On Monday we were able to change the room by 7 pm but the system was down so they said that they couldn't program the key for the new room, so the solution for that night was to send someone to open the room for us.

Após o check-out, pudemos continuar aproveitando nas dependências do hotel até chegar o horário da ida ao aeroporto e nos concederam um banheiro privado para tomarmos banho. Foi essencial! / Na minha reserva havia um crédito de U$200 para utilizar em serviços do Hotel. Este foi um diferencial para eu fechar através do Booking, pois paguei mais caro do que na Concorrência e no próprio site do hotel, pois entendi que compensaria pois utilizaria o crédito. Para minha surpresa, me foi informado pelo hotel que esse "crédito" na verdade não poderia ser utilizado para custear 100% qualquer serviço do Hotel, este era desmembrado em descontos que eu poderia utilizar em diversos serviços. por exemplo... para fazer a massagem que custava 190 dólares, eu poderia utilizar 50 dólares deste crédito somente,ou seja, não conseguiria utilizar sem ter que pagar a diferença de cada serviço prestado. acabei não utilizando nada do crédito pois não compensava. Me senti completamente lesada, pois o correto neste caso, seriam esclarecer que o cliente ganharia um desconto de U$200 que poderia ser utilizado parcial e proporcionalmente em diferentes serviços.

reviews.text: I visited Paradisus way before covid and I booked there during covid but it was closed and they automatically booked me for circles which was not that great plus I was not told in advance that they were rerouting people there. I think Paradisus have new workers that does not know how to deliver the GREAT customer service that the old employees used to deliver in the past. / So I literally was on my way to Sineris to check out there aqua park with my son and my niece but since last time I was in Punta Cana Paradisus was closed. I literally drove to the security and asked if it was open and the gentleman at the gate said yes but you need a reservation. I went right to my booking app and made a reservation for 4. When I got there mind you it was like 10pm and we just had a long day coming from Santo Domingo to check out Katmandu. The gentle man at the front desk told that I had a room for 3 adults, I said no incorrect and I showed him my booking app reservation, and clearly said 2 adults and 2 children with the ages of the children. The gentleman at the front desk was very accommodating at first. He told that they were checking for a room and that it will take 5 minutes, then he said they were preparing the room and fixing the sofa bed for the kids. All that was understandable since my reservation differs from what they could see on their end. He then offered us a welcome drink which was passion juice. I sensed that there was some issues with my accommodation and went up to check and he said that it would be a few more minutes, we were tired and getting a bit cranky. He then came and told me that they would have to take a hold of $104 because booking made a mistake, which was fine cause I was too tired to care. Finally the room was ready and when we went up none of our keys worked and  it was just one bed and no sofa bed was made. I went downstairs and they told me to wait and they will fix the issue about  minutes went by and I was told that housekeeping was going to bring a pull out bed to the room. Since I was already in the room I new that that was not going to work. At this point I was fed up and just asked for my money back. Let me just add that I unfortunately did not catch the gentleman's name but he was very nice and tried to accommodate us the entire time the best that he could the manager was the issue.
